resources.string: Back up or restore your setup
Scan the code with your phone. You can save a backup file of your profiles, home rows and settings there, or send one back to this TV.
Backup
Saves your profiles, home rows (favourites order, hidden apps, icon styles), widgets and settings in one file on this phone. Not included: your Gemini key, your own pictures and icons.
Save backup to this phone
Restore from a backup file

Add your TMDB key
Scan the code with your phone and paste your free TMDB API key there. You get one at themoviedb.org → Settings → API.
TMDB key
Paste your TMDB “API Key” or “API Read Access Token” (themoviedb.org → Settings → API). It is checked with TMDB and kept only on your TV.
